## How to test

Commands run and their results (fmt / clippy / test).

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and passing.
- [ ] `cargo fmt` clean (touched lines only — do not reformat untouched files).
- [ ] `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` clean.
- [ ] Docs / `CHANGELOG.md` updated if user-facing.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in the diff.
- [ ] Breaking changes listed below (if any).

None / describe them here.

## Security review

- [ ] This change touches policy, guard, auth, or the tool surface — and the security impact is described above.
